purpose: Exploratory synthetic regression evidence; not a strategy promotion, calibrated bidder comparison or human quality claim.
groupBy: All modes, seats and policies sharing a deal seed stay together.
acceptance: Every synthetic hand terminates with legal actions and 13 resolved tricks.
